headline: Taichung Business Tax Doubles in 8 Years; Actual Collection of NT$52.7 Billion Last Year Hits Record High - Liberty Finance
summary: Ministry of Finance statistics show Taichung's net business tax collection reached NT$52.7 billion last year, up from NT$26.1 billion in 2018. Collection has doubled over the eight years.
why: Business tax revenue reflects local commercial activity and the fiscal capacity of municipal governments, which in turn affects public spending and infrastructure.
